# Detailed gap file — module `hr`

**How Claude Code should use this file.** Each item below was re-checked against the real source in a second, deeper pass (verdict + evidence + files + steps + acceptance). Work `ACTION` items page by page. Do NOT implement `REFUTED` items (kept at the bottom for audit). `CANNOT-VERIFY` and `BACKEND-VERIFY` items need the named service or a decision — check, don't guess. Prefer the shared fixes in `SHARED_FIXES.md` first: many items here disappear once those land. Follow `CLAUDE.md` (paise money, audit events on mutations, zod at the boundary, no cross-module joins, no console.log). Model-verified, not human-reviewed: for money, approval and PII items, read the code yourself before merging.

Counts: ACTION 521, BACKEND-VERIFY 2, CANNOT-VERIFY 2, REFUTED 12

### GAP-HR-HOME-01  ·  HIGH  ·  confirmed  ·  theme ROLEGATE

- [x] **Status** — PR #1666 (merged): `hrTileAccess.ts` added, hub filters all 88 tiles via an `href -> roles` map mirroring each destination's own already-enforced gate. Independently re-verified via an exhaustive sweep of all 86 destination pages (two rounds — first round found 2 misses, `salary-slips`/`pensioners`, fixed and re-swept clean). SF-20's other ~29 catalog-counted hr items were investigated and are either already-REFUTED `workforce/*` stubs or owned by GAP-HR-SF-09b (tracked in `tests/contract/hr-role-matrix.allowlist.json`) — this was the one real, buildable SF-20 item for hr.
- **First-pass claim:** Every role in HR_ROLES sees every tile: hr/layout.tsx admits employee/manager, but page.tsx has no role filtering, so an employee sees Payroll Runs, Vigilance, Disciplinary, RTI, DPC, Audit Log tiles that 403 or PermissionDenied on click (page.tsx:19-166 vs layout.tsx:36-46).
- **Verified evidence:** apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/layout.tsx:32-42 HR_ROLES includes manager and employee (requireAnyRole at 45); apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/page.tsx builds all 13 categories with no session role look-up and passes them straight to HRHubNavigation, which has no role prop. So an employee sees Payroll, Vigilance, Disciplinary, RTI, DPC, Audit Log tiles; destinations are protected by their own gates (e.g. disciplinary/page.tsx:42 PermissionDenied) or API 403. Not verified for every one of the 88 destinations.
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/page.tsx`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/_components/HRHubNavigation.tsx`, `apps/web/src/lib/auth/hrTileAccess.ts (new)`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Extend NavTile usage locally with optional roles?: string[] (or a map href -> roles in hrTileAccess.ts mirroring each destination's guard).
  2. In Page, call getSessionRoles() (@/lib/auth/roleGuard) and filter tiles by roles, dropping empty categories, before passing to HRHubNavigation.
  3. Employees/managers get a small self-service set (leave apply, attendance, payslips, directory, holidays, service book).
  4. Keep server checks untouched; add a test that every tile href has an entry.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Render as employee: no Payroll Runs/Vigilance/Disciplinary/Audit Log tiles.
  - hr_admin still sees all 88 tiles.
- **Needs:** web  ·  **Effort:** M ~1-2d  ·  **Risk:** Hiding must not be the only guard; wrong mapping could hide a needed tile from a valid role.

## /hr/advances  —  `hr/advances.html`

- **Source:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/advances/page.tsx`
- **Design reference:** `redesign/hr/advances.html`

### GAP-HR-ADVANCES-01  ·  HIGH  ·  confirmed  ·  theme UUID

- [x] **Status** — PR #1698 (merged): employeeName/employeeNo resolved via the existing shared batchEmployees helper, no raw UUID fallback.
- **First-pass claim:** Employee column shows the raw employeeId UUID for every row: GET /salary-advances spreads the table row with no name/number join (loans-routes.ts:175-187) and mapAdvances falls back to a.employeeId (mapAdvances.ts:39-41). The reviewer cannot tell whose advance it is.
- **Verified evidence:** GET /salary-advances (services/hrms-service/src/modules/employee/loans-routes.ts:175-187) selects hrmsSalaryAdvances only and spreads each row (bigints to Number); no employee join. mapAdvances.ts:136-138 uses a.employee?.name, which is never present, so it falls back to a.employeeId (raw UUID) in the Employee column (page.tsx:59). The layer tag is right: the fix is in the service.
- **Files to change:** `services/hrms-service/src/modules/employee/loans-routes.ts`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/employee/queries.ts`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/advances/mapAdvances.ts`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Add an in-module helper in employee/queries.ts (e.g. employeeNamesByIds(tenantId, ids) reading hrms_employees, same module, no cross-schema join) that returns id -> {name, employeeNo}.
  2. In the GET /v1/hrms/salary-advances handler, call it once for the distinct employeeIds and add employeeName and employeeNo to each returned row (keep existing fields).
  3. Update ApiAdvance in mapAdvances.ts with employeeName/employeeNo and build the Employee cell as `${employeeName} (${employeeNo})`; if name is missing show '—', never the UUID.
  4. Add the new fields to the response schema/contract if the route is validated (sendValidated) and update the mapAdvances unit test.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Unit test mapAdvances: row with employeeName='A Kumar', employeeNo='E101' renders 'A Kumar (E101)'; row without name renders '—' and never a UUID.
  - Service test: GET /salary-advances returns employeeName/employeeNo for each row and stays tenant-scoped.
  - Manual: /hr/advances shows names, no 36-char ids anywhere in the table.
- **Needs:** web+backend  ·  **Effort:** S ~half day  ·  **Risk:** Low. Read-only enrichment; keep manager scope (reportIds) filtering unchanged. Names are ordinary directory data, no salary/PII beyond what the employees list already exposes.
- **Depends on:** shared employee-name enrichment (also GAP-HR-APAR-02, GAP-HR-APAR-DETAIL-02)

### GAP-HR-ADVANCES-02  ·  HIGH  ·  confirmed  ·  theme WORKFLOW (was DEADROUTE)

- [x] **Status** — PR #1698 (merged): PATCH .../reject added (HR-only, reason required, same maker-checker as approve, pending-only guard) + migration 0158. Human-review requested on the maker-checker specifically.
- **First-pass claim:** Advances can never leave 'Pending' from the UI: PATCH /salary-advances/:id/approve exists (loans-routes.ts:222) but the page has no approve/reject control, and there is no reject endpoint at all, so the 'Rejected' stat card is unreachable via the API. Subtitle/empty copy promise HR approval.
- **Verified evidence:** advances/page.tsx has no approve or reject control (only RequestAdvanceForm + read-only DataTable). PATCH /v1/hrms/salary-advances/:id/approve exists (loans-routes.ts:~222, HR_ROLES, maker-checker: 403 if createdBy===actorId). There is no reject route in loans-routes.ts and no consumer writes 'rejected'. Extra defect found: the approve consumer (loans-consumer.ts:114-119) sets status='active', not 'approved', so page.tsx:42-43 counts (status==='approved' / 'rejected') are 0 even after approval; the 'Approved' card is also wrong. The en.json empty copy promises 'Advances are approved by HR'.
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/advances/page.tsx`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/advances/ApproveAdvanceButton.tsx`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/advances/mapAdvances.ts`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/employee/loans-routes.ts`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/employee/loans-consumer.ts`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Decide the status vocabulary (pending / active / rejected / completed) and make the stat cards in page.tsx count real statuses (approved card = status 'active' or 'completed', or have the consumer write 'approved').
  2. Create client component ApproveAdvanceButton.tsx (Button + confirm dialog) that PATCHes /api/proxy/v1/hrms/salary-advances/{id}/approve, shows useFormError message on 403/409, then router.refresh().
  3. Render it in a new Actions column only for rows with status 'pending', and only when the session has an HR_ROLES role (hr_admin, finance_admin, super_admin, hr_officer) and the row was not created by the current user (hide, server still enforces).
  4. Backend: add PATCH /salary-advances/:id/reject (HR_ROLES, same maker-checker precheck, reason required, zod body) plus a salaryAdvanceReject command/consumer setting status='rejected' and rejectedBy/reason, emitting an audit event; or drop the Rejected card if reject is out of scope.
  5. Change the subtitle/empty copy only if approval stays out of scope.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Component test: pending row shows Approve for hr_admin, none for manager; after click the PATCH is called with the row id and table refreshes.
  - Service test: approving own-created advance returns 403; reject route writes status 'rejected' and audit event.
  - Manual: approve one advance, stat card counts move Pending -> Approved.
- **Needs:** web+backend  ·  **Effort:** M ~1-2d  ·  **Risk:** Approvals and money: approver must never be creator (server rule must stay); status rename can break any report reading hrms_salary_advances.status='active'. Approve is async (202), so UI must not optimistically show approved.
- **Depends on:** GAP-HR-ADVANCES-04

## /hr/apar/[id]  —  `hr/apar-detail.html`

- **Source:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/apar/[id]/page.tsx`
- **Design reference:** `redesign/hr/apar-detail.html`

### GAP-HR-APAR-DETAIL-01  ·  HIGH  ·  confirmed  ·  theme MISSING-FEATURE (was I18N)

- [x] **Status** — PR #1741 (merged): all 6 backend stage-transition routes now have a real web caller (new AparStageActions.tsx, correct form per stage incl. live KRA-weight-sum-to-100 validation, confirm dialogs on Accept/Finalise). Gated by a new server-computed actions field (computeAparActions, reusing the same per-record stageOwner logic the write-side authority already used) — independently verified the frontend never independently re-derives ownership, only renders what the server returned.
- **First-pass claim:** Six backend stage-transition routes exist (apar/routes.ts:213–308) but the page only prints a notice "use the API" (page.tsx:227–231). The core Government APAR workflow — self-appraisal by 31 Mar-ish, RO pen picture with 100-weight KRAs, RvO concurrence/variation, AA grading, disclosure with 15-day representation window — cannot be performed from the UI at all.
- **Verified evidence:** Detail page renders read-only sections plus a notice (page.tsx:227-231, en.json aparDetail.workflowNoticeLine1/2: 'performed via the APAR workflow API'). Backend routes exist in apar/routes.ts: self-appraisal 213, reporting 225, reviewing 248, accept 268, representation 286, finalise 298; each enforces assertStageOwner (acting employee must own the stage; only super_admin may override). No web code calls them (no client component in [id]/). Related gap: representationDue is never written by apar/f3-consumer.ts, so the 15-day representation window is not implemented server-side either; POST replies are queued (publishF3Write) and return a computed status without reading the record, so the UI must refetch.
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/apar/[id]/page.tsx`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/apar/[id]/AparStageActions.tsx`, `apps/web/src/messages/en.json`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/apar/routes.ts`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/apar/f3-consumer.ts`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Backend: extend GET /v1/hrms/apar/:id to return `actions: { canAct: boolean, expectedStage: string, isOverride: boolean }` computed with stageOwner()/resolveEmployeeForActor, so the UI never guesses ownership.
  2. Create client component AparStageActions.tsx rendering one form per status: self_pending (textarea selfAppraisal), reporting_officer (pen picture + KRA rows attribute/weight/score 1-10, live check weights sum to 100), reviewing_officer (concur|vary + remarks + optional variations), accepting_authority (remarks), disclosed (representation textarea), and HR-only Finalise. Validate with the same zod shapes as the routes.
  3. POST to /api/proxy/v1/hrms/apar/{id}/<step>, use useFormError for 403 NOT_STAGE_OWNER / 409 WRONG_STAGE, then router.refresh() (consider a short poll since writes are queued).
  4. Render the component under the details card only when actions.canAct; replace the workflow notice with read-only text otherwise.
  5. Backend: set representationDue = disclosedAt + 15 days in the accept consumer (confirm the rule with HR) so the disclosure window exists.
  6. Move all new strings to aparDetail.* i18n keys.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Component test: at status reporting_officer the form rejects weights not summing to 100 and posts the correct body to /reporting.
  - Manual end-to-end: create APAR, walk all seven stages as the assigned officers; each hand-off shows the next officer's form and history rows.
  - Non-owner sees no form and a read-only message; API 403 is shown clearly if forced.
- **Needs:** web+backend  ·  **Effort:** L >2d  ·  **Risk:** High: statutory appraisal record, four-eyes chain and audit history. Never derive ownership client-side; server assertStageOwner stays the authority. Queued writes can look unsaved on refresh; scores are final after Accept so confirm dialogs are needed.
- **Depends on:** GAP-HR-APAR-DETAIL-02, GAP-HR-APAR-NEW-01

- **Verified evidence:** services/hrms-service/src/modules/attendance/queries.ts:51 `department: empMap.get(r.employeeId)?.departmentId.slice(0,8) ?? ""` (first 8 chars of a UUID) and :56 `hoursWorked: undefined`. AttendanceTable.tsx:36-37 (columns) prints department as-is and hours as '—' when null. employee module already has hrms_departments (employee/schema.ts, employee/repo.ts) in the same service DB, so a name join is legal; attendance rows carry inTime/outTime (attendance/schema.ts:41-42, TIME columns) from which hours can be derived.
- **Files to change:** `services/hrms-service/src/modules/attendance/queries.ts`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/employee/repo.ts`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/attendance/AttendanceTable.tsx`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Add employee-module repo fn (e.g. listDepartmentNames(tenantId) -> Map<id,name>) and call it from listAttendance (via employee repo, not a cross-module table import) to set department = name, falling back to '' not the id.
  2. Compute hoursWorked = (outTime - inTime) in hours (rounded to 2dp) when both present and outTime > inTime, else undefined; keep zod AttendanceSummaryListSchema in sync (packages/types).
  3. Keep cache key/invalidation: listOrLoad cache must be invalidated when departments rename.
  4. Web: no change except show '—' for empty department.
- **Acceptance:**

  - No UUID fragment visible in Department column.
- **Needs:** backend  ·  **Effort:** S ~half day  ·  **Risk:** Low: read model only; watch cache invalidation and the 500-employee listByTenant cap at queries.ts:47 (names/departments beyond 500 fall back to id).

### GAP-HR-AUDIT-LOG-01  ·  HIGH  ·  confirmed  ·  theme FAILMASK

- [x] **Status** — PR #1699 (merged): genuinely empty trail vs a real fetch failure no longer the same screen; failure shows LoadErrorState (403 -> PermissionDenied).
- **First-pass claim:** An audit trail with zero HR events shows the error badge, never the 'No audit records' EmptyState: mapAuditRows returns null when nothing maps (apps/web/src/app/_data/loaders.ts:432) and fetchJson turns null into source 'error' (apps/web/src/app/_data/apiClient.ts:155-158).
- **Verified evidence:** loaders.ts:413-433 mapAuditRows: getArrayPayload returns [] for an empty data array, the loop adds nothing, and line 432 `return mapped.length > 0 ? mapped : null`. apiClient.ts:~150-158 treats mapped===null as invalid_payload and returns {source:'error'}. So a tenant/user with zero matching HR audit events shows the error badge and the empty-state copy, never a clean 'No audit records'. Same `mapped.length>0 ? mapped : null` idiom is used in ~20 mappers in loaders.ts. Payload rows lacking actor or action are also silently dropped (line 429), which can turn a non-empty response into an 'error'. The auditEventsListSchema and the audit endpoint are not in the snapshot (services/ only has hrms-service), so real payload shape is cannot-verify.
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/_data/loaders.ts`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. In mapAuditRows return `mapped` (possibly []) whenever getArrayPayload succeeded; return null only when the payload is not an array.
  2. Return null if rows.length>0 but mapped.length===0 (all rows unparseable) so genuine shape drift is still flagged.
  3. Audit other `mapped.length > 0 ? mapped : null` mappers for the same issue (systemic).
- **Acceptance:**
  - Unit test: mapAuditRows({data: []}) returns [] and page shows EmptyState with no error badge.
  - Unit test: mapAuditRows({data:[{foo:1}]}) returns null.
  - Populated payload unchanged.
- **Needs:** web  ·  **Effort:** S ~half day  ·  **Risk:** Low; but changing the shared idiom across loaders needs per-screen review so real errors are not hidden.

### GAP-HR-CONFIRMATION-01  ·  HIGH  ·  confirmed  ·  theme WORKFLOW (was CONFIRM)

- [~] **Status** — PR #1704 (merged): real service-record confirm workflow, server-side gated. W2 hr rescan (INTERIM, PARTIAL): designation is returned (earlier work) and the card no longer claims "Awaiting Manager" when the API carries no recommendation — it shows 'No manager recommendation on record' while an explicit pending / recommended / not_recommended value still renders as given; Confirm and Extend are deliberately NOT gated; tests in ProbationConfirmationCard.test.tsx. NOT BUILT (owner decision): the recommendation store and endpoint, managerRecommendation on GET /v1/hrms/confirmations, gating Confirm on it, and the manager-facing entry point. OWNER QUESTIONS: (1) who records the recommendation — the reporting manager (direct reports only), HR on the manager's behalf, or both; (2) is it mandatory before HR can Confirm (hard block, or Confirm with a required override remark); (3) may a recorded recommendation be changed or withdrawn. A migration will be needed once decided.
- **First-pass claim:** Manager recommendation never exists: GET /confirmations returns no managerRecommendation or designation (services/hrms-service/src/modules/lifecycle/m7-list-routes.ts:207-216), so every card reads 'Awaiting Manager' and designation '—'. The UI has no way to record a recommendation, yet Confirm is offered regardless.
- **Verified evidence:** services/hrms-service/src/modules/lifecycle/m7-list-routes.ts:178-215 (GET /v1/hrms/confirmations) selects only id, fullName, departmentId, dateOfJoining, confirmationDate, status and returns {id, employee, department, joiningDate, probationEnd, dueDate, status}; no designation and no managerRecommendation. ProbationConfirmationCard.tsx:73 defaults `row.managerRecommendation ?? 'pending'` so every card shows 'Awaiting Manager', and :99 shows designation '—'. Confirm button (isActionable, :~118) depends only on row.status === 'probation'. No recommendation table/endpoint was found under hrms-service/src/modules. The existing <ConfirmDialog> is already used (card :~190); the listed fix is not the gap.
- **Files to change:** `services/hrms-service/src/modules/lifecycle/m7-list-routes.ts`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/lifecycle/schema.ts`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/lifecycle/validators.ts`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/confirmation/_components/ProbationConfirmationCard.tsx`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. DECISION first: who records the recommendation (reporting manager via a new POST/PATCH /v1/hrms/employees/:id/confirmation-recommendation, or HR on the manager's behalf) and whether it is mandatory before Confirm.
  2. Backend: add a recommendation store (employee_id, recommendation enum recommended|not_recommended, remark, recorded_by, recorded_at) in the lifecycle module with an audit() call, plus a zod body in lifecycle/validators.ts.
  3. In GET /v1/hrms/confirmations join designation via existing batchDesignations() and batch-load latest recommendation; return designation and managerRecommendation.
  4. In ProbationCard, when managerRecommendation is 'pending'/null disable Confirm (or require ConfirmDialog requireReason with an override remark) and show 'Awaiting Manager' only when truly pending.
  5. Add a manager-facing entry point (manager role is allowed into /hr by layout.tsx) to record the recommendation.
- **Acceptance:**
  - API test: GET /confirmations returns designation and managerRecommendation for a probationer with a recorded recommendation.
  - Component test: row with managerRecommendation=null renders Confirm disabled (or override-reason path) and 'Awaiting Manager'.
  - Manual: manager records 'Recommended' -> card shows Recommended and Confirm enabled for HR.
- **Needs:** decision  ·  **Effort:** L >2d  ·  **Risk:** Service-record event; gating Confirm on a recommendation changes HR workflow and may block legitimate confirmations if managers are slow - needs policy sign-off.
- **Depends on:** GAP-HR-CONFIRMATION-03

### GAP-HR-CONFIRMATION-02  ·  HIGH  ·  confirmed  ·  theme CONFIRM

- [x] **Status** — PR #1704 (merged): orderRef now required on confirm (verified via regression test, including a sibling test fixed on independent review to match).
- **First-pass claim:** Confirm acts on the click date, not a decided date: ProbationConfirmationCard.tsx sends confirmationDate = today and there is no order/authority reference, no reviewer remark, no date picker. A confirmation is a formal service-record event (backdated orders are normal) — and the dialog says it 'cannot be undone from here'.
- **Verified evidence:** ProbationConfirmationCard.tsx:~76 builds `confirmationDate = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)` (UTC date, not IST) and PATCHes /api/proxy/v1/hrms/employees/:id/confirm with only {confirmationDate}. The backend body (employee/validators.ts:56 confirmEmployeeBody) accepts only confirmationDate (YYYY-MM-DD), so no order no./authority/remark can be sent; consumer employee/consumer.ts:73-105 stores it and writes an audit. The <ConfirmDialog> (card ~:190) has no requireReason and no date picker; its description says 'as of today ... cannot be undone from here'. Also `confirm()` from useConfirmAction accepts a reason but the card calls `confirm()` without it.
- **Files to change:** `services/hrms-service/src/modules/employee/validators.ts`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/employee/consumer.ts`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/employee/schema.ts`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/confirmation/_components/ProbationConfirmationCard.tsx`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Extend confirmEmployeeBody with orderRef (string 1..64, required), authority (optional) and remark; keep confirmationDate but reject future dates and dates before dateOfJoining.
  2. Persist orderRef/remark (service-book entry or employee columns) in employee/consumer.ts employeeConfirm handler and include them in the audit() payload.
  3. In ProbationCard replace the implicit 'today' with a controlled date input (default today in IST) and order-ref input, rendered inside ConfirmDialog via its description slot or a new form step; pass requireReason with reasonLabel 'Remark / authority' to ConfirmDialog and forward `confirm(reason)` into the PATCH body.
  4. Update dialog copy to state the chosen effective date, not 'today'.
  5. Use formatIndianDate for display; compute default date with Asia/Kolkata.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Unit test: PATCH with confirmationDate earlier than dateOfJoining or in the future returns 400.
  - Component test: Confirm button in dialog disabled until date and order ref are filled; request body contains chosen date, orderRef, remark.
  - Manual: backdated confirmation shows the chosen date in the service book and audit log.
- **Needs:** web+backend  ·  **Effort:** M ~1-2d  ·  **Risk:** Backdating affects increments/seniority computed downstream; validate bounds and keep audit trail of who entered the date.

### GAP-HR-CONFIRMATION-06  ·  MEDIUM  ·  confirmed  ·  theme DATETIME (was DATEFMT)

- [x] **Status** — PR #1704 (merged): IST-aware due-dates.
- **First-pass claim:** Overdue/due-soon buckets use a string compare of dueDate against today's ISO date and Math.ceil of a day diff computed on the server clock (page.tsx:31-40); an unparseable dueDate ('—' when joining date is null) silently lands in 'Timely'.
- **Verified evidence:** confirmation/page.tsx:28-40: today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) (UTC date; between 00:00-05:30 IST it is yesterday), overdue = string compare dueDate < today, dueSoon uses Math.ceil((Date.parse(dueDate)-Date.now())/86400000) <= 30. For an unparseable dueDate (e.g. '—'), '—' < '2026-..' is false and NaN <= 30 is false so it falls into 'Timely' (timely = total - overdue - dueSoon). The card (ProbationConfirmationCard.tsx daysDiff) returns null and prints 'Date not set' for the same row, so page stats and card disagree. Practically, dateOfJoining is NOT NULL so '—' arises only from bad data.
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/confirmation/page.tsx`, `apps/web/src/lib/formatters.ts`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/confirmation/_components/ProbationConfirmationCard.tsx`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Create a shared helper daysUntilIST(isoDate): number | null in lib/formatters.ts (compare calendar dates in Asia/Kolkata, not Date.now diff).
  2. Use it in both page.tsx and ProbationCard.daysDiff so buckets and card labels agree.
  3. Add an explicit fourth bucket 'Date not set' (null days) and exclude it from Timely.
  4. Add unit tests covering IST midnight boundaries and invalid dates.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Unit test: dueDate '—' counts in 'Date not set', not Timely.
  - Unit test: at 2026-03-01T19:00Z (IST 2026-03-02) a dueDate of 2026-03-01 is overdue.
  - Stat cards sum to items.length.
- **Needs:** web  ·  **Effort:** S ~half day  ·  **Risk:** Low; changes counts of overdue by up to one day at IST boundary.

'').toLowerCase()` in ['contract','contractual']; neither field is sent (the field is employeeType), so filter drops every row and the register shows the empty state. The page also fetches only limit=50 of ALL employee types (:63). The backend already supports `?employeeType=` (employee/validators.ts:10-11 employeeListQuery, passed to repo.listByTenant) and legacy type 'contract' exists (engagement-policy.ts LEGACY_EMPLOYEE_TYPES) with canonical 'contractual' engagement category; which code a tenant uses cannot be verified from the snapshot (tenant engagement-type master data).

  3. Confirm the engagement code with the tenant's employee-type master (GET /v1/hrms/employee-types) and constant-ise it.

### GAP-HR-CONTRACTUAL-02  ·  HIGH  ·  confirmed  ·  theme OTHER

No web page currently calls /hrms/contracts (grep of apps/web found none). Add an enriched listing (e.g. GET /v1/hrms/contracts?include=employee) in the contracts module that returns contractNo, startDate, endDate, status, renewalCount plus employee name, department, designation and agencyRef, resolved through an in-process employee query interface (no cross-module SQL join).

### GAP-HR-CONTRACTUAL-03  ·  MEDIUM  ·  confirmed  ·  theme PAGINATION (was CAP)

- [x] **Status** — PR #1727 (merged): pagination/truncation honesty fixed. Rescan follow-up: the register is paged server-side (50 per page, ?page=, Previous/Next links, 'Showing a-b of total'), the banner/pager is driven by meta.total instead of an items.length heuristic, and every stat card (Total, Active, Expiring, Expired, Agencies) is the server's full-scope summary (GET /v1/hrms/contracts?summary=true, manager-scoped). Tests: contracts-list-summary-real-db.test.ts, contractual/page.test.tsx (120 contracts across 3 pages). (W2 hr rescan: completed by #PRNUM)
- **First-pass claim:** limit=50 is applied server-side before the client filter (page.tsx:63), so contractual staff beyond the first 50 employees are never seen; the truncation banner (page.tsx:97) is triggered by 50 employees of any type, not by 50 contractual ones.
- **Verified evidence:** contractual/page.tsx:63 fetches `/api/v1/hrms/employees?limit=50` (all types), :46-49 filters client-side afterwards, and :78 `isTruncated = items.length >= 50` is evaluated on the already-filtered contractual rows, not on the raw fetch. So the observation's last clause is inverted: the banner triggers when 50 CONTRACTUAL rows survive the filter, whereas contractual staff beyond the first 50 employees of any type are silently lost with no banner. DataTable pageSize=15 paginates locally only; pagination.hasMore from the API is ignored.
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/contractual/page.tsx`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Filter server-side (?employeeType=contractual, or the contracts endpoint) so the 50-row window is all contractual.
  2. Read pagination.hasMore / total from the response and drive the truncation banner from it, not from items.length.
  3. Add page/offset search params and prev/next controls (or a server-side DataTable) with a total count.
  4. Compute stat cards from a server aggregate rather than the current page.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Test: 120 contractual staff -> page 1 shows 50, banner/pager indicates more, page 2 loads the rest.
  - Stat 'Total' equals the server total, not 50.
- **Needs:** web+backend  ·  **Effort:** M ~1-2d  ·  **Risk:** Low; shares the same paging approach as other list pages.
- **Depends on:** GAP-HR-CONTRACTUAL-01, GAP-HR-CONTRACTUAL-02

## /hr/dashboard  —  `hr/dashboard.html`

- **Source:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/dashboard/page.tsx`
- **Design reference:** `redesign/hr/dashboard.html`

### GAP-HR-DASHBOARD-01  ·  HIGH  ·  partly  ·  theme CONFIRM

- [x] **Status** — PR #1759 (merged): already done on main (verified in review)
- **First-pass claim:** Leave approve/decline fire immediately from the inbox with no confirmation, no reason for rejection and no leave balance or overlap context (ActionInbox.tsx act(): PATCH …/approve|reject on click); an accidental click on a compact row rejects a staff member's leave.
- **Verified evidence:** ActionInbox.tsx:30-43 act() sends `PATCH /api/proxy/v1/hrms/leave-applications/${id}/${action}` immediately on click (buttons :84-95), no dialog, no reason, no balance/overlap context - true. But the rejection is not silently executed today: the reject route (leave/routes.ts:269-278) parses rejectLeaveBody = {reason: string.min(1)} (leave/validators.ts:40), and act() sends no body, so decline fails validation (400) and shows the error text in-row (errors[id], :80-82) with the buttons then removed for that row (no retry). Approve has no body requirement, so approve fires immediately. Additionally approve/reject require HR_ROLES (routes.ts:252-262: managers get 403 WORKFLOW_REQUIRED), yet the inbox is shown to managers (page.tsx:41 HR_DASHBOARD_READER_ROLES incl. manager). Server enforces maker-checker (SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN, routes.ts:260-262) and audit via commands. The full approvals UI (hr/leave/approvals/LeaveApprovalsPanel.tsx) already uses dialogs with reasons.
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/dashboard/_components/ActionInbox.tsx`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/dashboard/page.tsx`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Wrap approve and decline in <ConfirmDialog> / useConfirmAction (ds/ActionButton.tsx); decline uses requireReason and sends JSON body {reason} with content-type application/json.
  2. Show employee, dates, days and department in the dialog description; link to /hr/leave/approvals for balance/overlap context.
  3. Only render Approve/Decline buttons for hr_admin/hr_officer/super_admin (pass canDecide prop from page.tsx); for managers show 'Open in Approvals' link to the workflow queue.
  4. On error keep the buttons and show a retry rather than removing them; surface 403 SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN text.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Component test: clicking Decline opens dialog; Confirm disabled until reason entered; PATCH body contains reason.

### GAP-HR-DEPARTMENTS-NEW-01  ·  HIGH  ·  confirmed  ·  theme OTHER

- [x] **Status** — PR #1750 (merged)
- **First-pass claim:** No Parent Department, Type, Head or Location fields although the tree page and backend hierarchy rules rely on them (AddDepartmentForm.tsx body is {code,name}; masters-routes.ts:55-72 accepts parentId/level) — every department created here is a root, so 'Sub-Departments' can never be populated from the UI.
- **Verified evidence:** AddDepartmentForm.tsx:80-84 POSTs `JSON.stringify({ code, name })` only and renders only Code and Name inputs. Backend createDeptBody (employee/masters-routes.ts:28-36) accepts parentId (uuid), type, level, govtTier, locationId, headEmployeeId, and POST /departments (:55-72) enforces child.level > parent.level when both given; f3-consumer.ts:286-297 inserts them. departments/DepartmentsTable.tsx and departments/page.tsx:26,64-65 count root vs sub departments via parentId, which will always be null for departments created here. Role check in new/page.tsx:15 (hr_admin, super_admin, admin) matches masters-routes HR_ROLES:26.
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/departments/new/AddDepartmentForm.tsx`, `apps/web/src/messages/en.json`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Add a Parent Department <select> populated from GET /api/proxy/v1/hrms/departments (or pass a server-loaded list as prop from page.tsx) with an empty 'None (top-level)' option; send parentId and derive level = parent.level + 1 (client hint; server enforces HIERARCHY_VIOLATION).
  2. Add optional Type text/select, Govt tier select (central|state|local_body|statutory_body|autonomous_body) and Head (employee picker) - hide Location until location-service picker exists.
  3. Validate with a shared zod schema mirroring createDeptBody before submit.
  4. Map 400 HIERARCHY_VIOLATION to a field error on the Parent select.
  5. Add i18n keys for the new labels.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Component test: choosing a parent posts parentId and level parent.level+1.
  - After creating, /hr/departments shows the new department under the parent and Sub-Departments count increments.
  - Selecting a parent then invalid level returns a visible field error.
- **Needs:** web  ·  **Effort:** M ~1-2d  ·  **Risk:** Wrong parent/level corrupts the org tree; the server-side level check only runs when both level values exist.

### GAP-HR-DEPARTMENTS-NEW-02  ·  MEDIUM  ·  partly  ·  theme CONFIRM

- [x] **Status** — PR #1750 (merged)
- **First-pass claim:** POST answers 202 with an id after publishing a command (masters-routes.ts:55-72 pattern); the form shows 'added successfully' and redirects before the write is confirmed, and duplicate-code conflicts surface late or not at all.
- **Verified evidence:** POST /v1/hrms/departments (masters-routes.ts:55-72) validates the body, publishes via publishF3Write and answers 202 {id, status:'created'}; the insert happens in f3-consumer.ts:286-297 (employee_masters_routes__0). AddDepartmentForm.tsx:87-100 treats any res.ok as success, shows t('successMsg') ('added successfully', en.json addDepartmentForm.successMsg) and NewDepartmentPageClient.tsx redirects after 1.5s. The route has NO synchronous duplicate-code check (only hierarchy), and this snapshot has no SQL migration to confirm a unique (tenant_id, code) index (cannot-verify); if one exists, the consumer insert fails asynchronously after the user was told success, if not, duplicates are silently created. Fix text (ConfirmDialog/maker-checker) is irrelevant for a master-data create.
- **Files to change:** `services/hrms-service/src/modules/employee/masters-routes.ts`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/departments/new/AddDepartmentForm.tsx`, `apps/web/src/messages/en.json`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. In the POST route add a synchronous pre-check (scopedRead by tenantId + code, case-insensitive) returning 409 DUPLICATE_CODE before publishing, mirroring the PATCH 404 pre-check pattern; DB unique index (tenant_id, lower(code)) as backstop.
  2. Map 409 to a field error under Code via formError.fieldError('code').
  3. Change the success message to 'Department submitted - it will appear in the list shortly' and refresh the list rather than claiming it exists.
  4. Confirm the migration state for a unique index (needs the DB migrations, absent from snapshot).
- **Acceptance:**
  - API test: posting an existing code returns 409 and publishes nothing.
  - Form test: 409 shows an error on Code and no redirect.
  - Manual: after success the department appears on /hr/departments.
- **Needs:** web+backend  ·  **Effort:** S ~half day  ·  **Risk:** Low; must scope duplicate check by tenant.
- **Depends on:** GAP-HR-DEPARTMENTS-NEW-03

### GAP-HR-DEPUTATION-01  ·  HIGH  ·  confirmed  ·  theme STATUS

- [x] **Status** — PR #1726 (merged): real status vocabulary.
- **First-pass claim:** Status vocabulary mismatch: backend deputations are active → repatriated | cancelled (deputation/routes.ts:87, 143-144) but the page counts "completed" and "recalled" (page.tsx:25-26) and the card checks recallStatus === "initiated" (DeputationCard.tsx:86). "Completed" is always 0, the "Recalled" card can never appear, and repatriated/cancelled rows fall through StatusPill's default "info" tone.
- **Verified evidence:** Backend statuses are active|repatriated|cancelled (deputation/schema.ts:39; routes.ts:87,111,143-144); list route passes r.status through (m7-list-routes.ts:32). page.tsx:25-26 counts 'completed' and 'recalled' (and :24 'pending', which the backend never writes either), so Completed is always 0 and the Recalled card (:52) never shows. DeputationCard.tsx:175 keys on status==='recalled' || recallStatus==='initiated' (field never sent). StatusPill STATUS_MAP has neither repatriated nor cancelled, so they render tone 'info'; the card's STATUS_LABEL (:147-154) also lacks repatriated so the raw lowercase string is displayed. Cards are only rendered for active/pending, so the table pill is where it shows.
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/deputation/page.tsx`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/deputation/_components/DeputationCard.tsx`, `apps/web/src/app/_components/ds/StatusPill.tsx`, `apps/web/src/messages/en.json`, `apps/web/src/messages/hi.json`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Define a shared DeputationStatus = 'active'|'repatriated'|'cancelled' type and use it in DeputationRow.
  2. In page.tsx replace counts with active/repatriated/cancelled; drop pending and recalled; rename statCompleted->statRepatriated, statRecalled->statCancelled (en+hi).
  3. Add repatriated:'mut' and cancelled:'bad'(or 'mut') to STATUS_MAP in StatusPill.tsx; update STATUS_LABEL in the card.
  4. Remove isRecalled/'Recall Initiated' logic in DeputationCard or drive it from cancelled.
  5. Filter the card grid on status==='active' only.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Unit test: rows [active, repatriated, cancelled] give counts 1/1/1.
  - StatusPill test: repatriated and cancelled produce non-'info' classes.
  - Manual: no dead 'Recalled' card path remains.
- **Needs:** web  ·  **Effort:** S ~half day  ·  **Risk:** Changing StatusPill map affects all pages using 'cancelled'/'repatriated'; check other callers (currently 'info' fallback).

### GAP-HR-DESIGNATIONS-01  ·  HIGH  ·  partly  ·  theme FABRICATED

- [~] **Status** — PR #1661 (merged): Grade Pay/6th-CPC mislabeling replaced with real 7th-CPC Group A/B/C classification (sourced from DoPT S.O. 3964(F), 9 Aug 2018), unified across DesignationsTable and the add-employee wizard. W2 hr rescan: PARTIAL. Done: the derived Service Group is now labelled 'indicative' (column header, tooltip and a footnote printing the bands), levels 1-18 all classify, no Grade Pay column or CPC7_GRADE_PAY remains. NOT done (needs an owner decision, not built): acceptance 'table renders only stored fields' - Service Group is still derived in the browser from payLevels.ts SERVICE_GROUP_BANDS, and HR has not signed off the band mapping. OWNER QUESTION: should Service Group be (a) a stored optional per-designation field set by HR (needs a migration adding service_group to employee.hrms_designations plus createDesignationBody/consumer/form changes) or (b) stay derived and indicative; and does HR confirm Group C = levels 1-5, B = 6-9, A = 10-18 (DoPT S.O. 3964(F))?
- **First-pass claim:** Grade Pay and Service Group are computed from a hard-coded browser table, not stored: CPC7_GRADE_PAY maps levels 1–14 to the old 6th-CPC grade pays (level 9 and 10 both 5,400) and stops at 14, so 7th-CPC levels 15–18 show '—' and every level is mislabelled '(7th CPC)' (DesignationsTable.tsx:14-20). Group boundaries (≤3 D, ≤5 C, ≤9 B) are also an assumption (DesignationsTable.tsx:22-28).
- **Verified evidence:** Real: Grade Pay and Service Group are computed in the browser from a hard-coded table, not stored (DesignationsTable.tsx:19-31,187-188). The map covers levels 1-14 only, so 15-18 render '—'. Overstated points: level 9 and 10 both 5,400 matches the historical 6th-CPC to Level mapping, so that is not itself an error; the '(7th CPC)' label is on the Pay Level column header (en.json colPayLevel), which is accurate for levels. The real problem is that Grade Pay is a 6th-CPC concept shown beside 7th-CPC levels, and Group boundaries (<=3 D, <=5 C, <=9 B) are an unstated assumption (Group D was merged into C after the 7th CPC).
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/designations/DesignationsTable.tsx`, `apps/web/src/messages/en.json`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/employee/schema.ts`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/employee/masters-routes.ts`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Decide with HR: remove the Grade Pay column entirely (7th CPC has no grade pay) or bind it to the pay-matrix endpoint; do not ship the hard-coded CPC7_GRADE_PAY.
  2. Replace derived Service Group with a stored optional field (add `serviceGroup` to hrms_designations, createDesignationBody and consumer) or drop the column; remove serviceGroup()/groupBadgeStyle heuristics.
  3. Update colGradePay/colServiceGroup/computedOnSave keys accordingly (en+hi).
  4. If kept as derived, label 'Indicative' and cover levels 1-18.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Test: no CPC7_GRADE_PAY constant remains; table renders only stored fields.
  - Level 16 row shows a value or a deliberate 'n/a' consistently.
- **Needs:** decision  ·  **Effort:** M ~1-2d  ·  **Risk:** Displays pay-related info to HR; wrong grade pay could mislead pay fixation.
- **Depends on:** GAP-HR-DESIGNATIONS-NEW-01

### GAP-HR-EMPLOYEES-DETAIL-01  ·  HIGH  ·  confirmed  ·  theme DATASCOPE (was OTHER)

- [x] **Status** — PR #1651 scoped `m7-list-routes.ts` (deputations); the sibling `lifecycle/routes.ts` (`/transfers`, `/promotions`) was never actually covered by that fix — unscoped tenant-wide since its creation (PR #611), not a later regression. Closed by PR #1676 (merged), independently reviewed twice with real red/green test runs. W2 hr rescan: the profile timeline shows an explicit "couldn't be loaded" alert when any transfers/promotions/deputation read fails (rejected or source error) instead of the empty-history message; rows naming another employee are filtered out defensively; the HR-only lists are only requested for HR roles; GET /v1/hrms/deputation rows now carry employeeId; new real-DB test tests/deputation-employee-scoping-real-db.test.ts plus web tests (page.lifecycle-status.test.tsx). (W2 hr rescan: completed by #PRNUM)
- **First-pass claim:** The lifecycle timeline shows other people's history: the page requests /lifecycle/transfers?employeeId=…, /lifecycle/promotions?employeeId=… and /deputation?employeeId=… but the transfer and promotion list routes select every tenant row and ignore employeeId (services/hrms-service/src/modules/lifecycle/routes.ts:15-22,31-38), and the deputation list does the same (lifecycle/m7-list-routes.ts:144-170). Every profile lists all transfers/promotions in the tenant — wrong for the viewer and a disclosure of colleagues' postings.
- **Verified evidence:** employees/[id]/page.tsx:31,38,45 request ?employeeId= for transfers, promotions and deputation. services/hrms-service/src/modules/lifecycle/routes.ts:15-22 (promotions) and :31-38 (transfers) filter only by tenantId and return every row; m7-list-routes.ts:143-170 (deputation) does the same with limit(500) and returns employee NAME, not employeeId, so the client cannot filter either. The page maps all returned rows into the timeline (page.tsx:54-89) so each profile shows the whole tenant's transfers/promotions/deputations. Routes are HR_ROLES only (hr_admin, hr_officer, super_admin), so the disclosure is among HR staff and other roles get an empty list silently (allSettled + source:'error' data []), but it is still wrong data on the wrong profile. (The service-book list at m7-list-routes.ts:119-124 does implement employeeId, showing the pattern.)
- **Files to change:** `services/hrms-service/src/modules/lifecycle/routes.ts`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/lifecycle/m7-list-routes.ts`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/employees/[id]/page.tsx`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Backend routes.ts: parse z.object({employeeId: z.string().uuid().optional()}).parse(req.query) in both list handlers and add and(eq(tenantId), eq(employeeId, q.employeeId)) when present (same as m7-list-routes.ts:119-124).
  2. Backend m7-list-routes.ts deputation handler: same optional employeeId filter; also include employeeId in the response rows.
  3. Web page.tsx: defensively filter mapped rows by employeeId === params.id when the field is present so an old backend cannot leak rows.
  4. Distinguish failure from empty in getLifecycleEvents (tRes.value.source === 'error') and show 'History unavailable' on the timeline card rather than silently omitting.
  5. Add a route test with two employees asserting only the requested employee's rows return.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Backend test: GET /lifecycle/transfers?employeeId=A returns only A's transfers.
  - Profile of employee B never shows a transfer to another employee's office.
  - Lifecycle load failure shows an explicit unavailable message.
- **Needs:** web+backend  ·  **Effort:** S ~half day  ·  **Risk:** High business risk as-is: transfers/promotions reveal postings and grades. Fix is a WHERE clause; check other callers of these list routes (transfer/promotion register pages) still work when the param is absent.

### GAP-HR-EMPLOYEES-DETAIL-EDIT-01  ·  HIGH  ·  confirmed  ·  theme WIRING (was UUID)

- [x] **Status** — PR #1759 (merged): already done on main (verified in review)
- **First-pass claim:** Manager field is initialised from employee.reportingTo (a display NAME, EditEmployeeForm.tsx useState(employee.reportingTo)) while the options and the PATCH expect a UUID: the select shows no current manager, and if the employee list fails to load the text input is prefilled with a name that would be sent as managerId if touched (validators.ts:75 requires uuid).
- **Verified evidence:** EditEmployeeForm.tsx:45 seeds managerId from employee.reportingTo, which services/hrms-service/src/modules/employee/queries.ts (reportingTo: manager.fullName) sets to the manager's display NAME. The select (:309-322) has option values = UUIDs, so a name matches no option and the placeholder shows. If /employees?limit=500 fails, the fallback text input (:323-332) is prefilled with the name. Submit compares with reportingTo (:120) so an untouched field is not sent (good), but any edit sends free text; updateEmployeeBody managerId is z.string().uuid() (validators.ts:75) so it 400s, and clearing to '' also 400s so a manager cannot be removed. The API now also returns managerId (queries.ts, 'managerId: emp.managerId') which the form should use; whether the web EmployeeDetail type exposes it cannot be verified (@civitasone/schemas is not in the snapshot).
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/employees/[id]/edit/EditEmployeeForm.tsx`, `apps/web/src/messages/en.json`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Seed state from (employee as {managerId?: string}).managerId ?? '' instead of reportingTo, and compare against that original at :120.
  2. Replace the select/text-input pair with the shared SmartCombobox (app/_components/SmartCombobox.tsx) that searches employees by name/number; exclude the employee themself; show current manager name as the selected label from reportingTo.
  3. Remove the free-text fallback: if the list fails show a disabled control with a retry, never a raw id input.
  4. Validate with a zod schema (uuid or empty=unchanged) before PATCH; only send managerId when changed and non-empty.
  5. If HR must be able to clear a manager, agree a backend contract first (nullable managerId) since updateEmployeeBody rejects null/empty.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Employee with a manager: select opens showing the manager's name pre-selected.
  - Saving with only email changed sends {email} and no managerId.
  - With the employees fetch mocked to fail, no text input prefilled with a name is rendered.
- **Needs:** web  ·  **Effort:** S ~half day  ·  **Risk:** Wrong managerId reroutes leave and approval flows; limit=500 dropdown also misses employees beyond 500 (use search).

### GAP-HR-EMPLOYEES-DETAIL-EDIT-02  ·  HIGH  ·  partly  ·  theme PII

- [x] **Status** — confirmed already fixed on current main. W2 hr rescan: masked phone/bank account are never seeded into inputs (shared ds MaskedField: read-only "Current: ..." + Change reveals an empty input, Keep current backs out); a changed account needs a matching confirmation, digits-only and a valid IFSC shape; updateEmployeeBody now rejects any '*' in mobile/bankAccountNo/bankIfsc (zod refine, commands.ts guard kept as backstop); tests in EditEmployeeForm.test.tsx, MaskedField.test.tsx, tests/employee-update-body-mask.test.ts. (W2 hr rescan: completed by #PRNUM)
- **First-pass claim:** Sensitive fields prefilled with masked values: phone, bank account and IFSC come back masked from the API (employee/queries.ts:89,101-103) and are placed straight into editable inputs; a partial edit of 'XXXXXX7890' saves a masked or corrupted account number that feeds salary disbursement. No re-entry confirmation, no reveal control and no field-level audit hint.
- **Verified evidence:** True: EditEmployeeForm.tsx:43 (phone), :49-50 (bankAccountNo, bankIfsc) seed inputs from API values that queries.ts masks with maskValue ('******7890'), shown in plain editable inputs (:375-386). Overstated: the submit only sends fields that differ from the original (:118,:136-137), and the backend refuses a fully-masked bank account/IFSC (commands.ts:226 isMaskedValue -> 400 MASKED_VALUE_REJECTED), so an untouched or star-only value is never persisted. A partially edited string that no longer matches the mask shape (e.g. '*****X7890') would still pass. Also found: PHONE_RE (:11) has no '*', so when an employee has a mobile the seeded masked phone fails validation at :106 and the form blocks with 'fix highlighted fields' unless the user retypes or clears the phone; the phone field cannot be left as is. UAN/ESIC/PRAN are unmasked by the API, so they are not affected. No reveal control, no re-entry confirmation.
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/employees/[id]/edit/EditEmployeeForm.tsx`, `apps/web/src/app/_components/ds/MaskedField.tsx`, `apps/web/src/messages/en.json`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Do not seed phone/bankAccountNo/bankIfsc state with masked values: start them empty and render the masked value as read-only helper text ('Current: ******7890').
  2. Create a shared MaskedField (input + 'Change' button) so the input only becomes editable after the user clicks Change; include only edited fields in the patch and skip the phone PHONE_RE check for untouched fields.
  3. Add a confirm-account-number second input (must equal first) and client validation of IFSC /^[A-Z]{4}0[A-Z0-9]{6}$/ and digits-only account before submit.
  4. Keep the server guard; additionally reject any bankAccountNo/mobile containing '*' in updateEmployeeBody (validators.ts) via zod refine.
  5. Add unit test for PHONE_RE regression: employee with phone '******3210' can save an email change.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Employee with mobile: changing only email saves (no 'fix highlighted fields' error).
  - Bank inputs are empty by default; typing an account number without matching confirmation blocks submit.
  - PATCH body never contains a value with '*'.
- **Needs:** web+backend  ·  **Effort:** M ~1-2d  ·  **Risk:** Bank details drive salary disbursement; a wrong account misdirects pay. Keep the server masked-value guard as backstop.
- **Depends on:** GAP-HR-EMPLOYEES-DETAIL-EDIT-03

### GAP-HR-EMPLOYEES-IMPORT-02  ·  HIGH  ·  confirmed  ·  theme VALIDATION

The consumer (employee/consumer.ts:29-70) inserts and any failure happens after the UI reported success. The status route (routes.ts:89-105) always returns 'completed' with no persisted batch (its own comment says so) and is not used. Note the batchId returned in the 202 is not persisted.

  2. Backend: persist a batch record (hrms_import_batches: id, tenantId, total, created, failed, per-row errors JSON) written by the employee create consumer; make GET /bulk/status/:batchId return real counts (or 404 for unknown id).

### GAP-HR-EMPLOYEES-IMPORT-03  ·  HIGH  ·  partly  ·  theme VALIDATION (was PII)

- [x] **Status** — PR #1679 (merged): tenant-scoped duplicate-employeeNo check added. Note: this new validation branch has zero test coverage per independent review — logic reads correct, non-blocking follow-up. W2 hr rescan: Review step before anything is sent: RFC 4180 reader (import/csv.ts: quoted commas and line breaks, escaped quotes, CRLF, BOM, unterminated-quote refusal), per-row client validation (required fields, real calendar date, email, mobile, in-file duplicate employeeNo, decimal-safe basic pay, column count), a preview of the first 10 rows with total / valid / skipped counts, and an explicit "Import N valid rows" confirm (invalid rows are skipped, never posted). (W2 hr rescan: completed by #PRNUM)
- **First-pass claim:** No preview or dry run: the file is parsed, codes resolved and posted in one click. CSV is split on ',' (ImportForm.tsx:47-58) so a quoted name like "Das, Rashmi Ranjan" or an amount like "44,900" shifts every later column and imports wrong data without an error; dates, mobile, gender and basicPay are not validated client-side (basicPay non-numeric becomes NaN → null).
- **Verified evidence:** True: no preview/dry run - handleSubmit (ImportForm.tsx:164-298) parses and posts in one step. Parser is naive: lines split on '\n' and cells on ',' with only leading/trailing quotes stripped (:172,175,184), so a quoted 'Das, Rashmi Ranjan' or '44,900' shifts every later column. Overstated: shifted data mostly fails loudly (a shifted email fails z.string().email(), departmentCode/designationCode lookups fail at :207 'unknown code', basicPay becomes non-integer or NaN), so silent wrong imports only occur when the shifted values happen to validate. Client does not validate dates/mobile/gender, but the server does: dateOfJoining regex, gender enum, email format (bulk-import/routes.ts:13-32); mobile only max 20 chars. basicPay NaN: Math.round(Number('abc')*100)=NaN serialises as null, which fails z.number().int() and is reported per row; it is not silently stored. Also: a header BOM is trimmed by String.trim; CRLF handled by trim. 'Das, Rashmi' style names are common, so the risk is real. Theme PII is a mis-tag.
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/employees/import/ImportForm.tsx`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/employees/import/csv.ts`, `apps/web/src/messages/en.json`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Replace the split-based parser with an RFC 4180 parser (small function in import/csv.ts handling quoted fields, embedded commas, escaped quotes, CRLF) or papaparse if allowed by dependency policy; add unit tests.
  2. Validate each row client-side with a zod schema (dateOfJoining YYYY-MM-DD real date, mobile digits 10, gender enum, basicPay rupees numeric >=0 with up to 2 decimals, employeeNo/fullName non-empty) and collect errors with line numbers before any network call.
  3. Convert basicPay to paise with a decimal-safe helper in lib/money.ts (no float multiplication: 44900.10*100 issues) and reject NaN.
  4. Add a preview step: after parse show first 10 rows, total count, count of invalid rows, and require an explicit 'Import N valid rows' click (skip invalid, or block).
  5. Add a header-count check: a row whose cell count differs from the header count is an error, not padded with ''.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Unit test: '"Das, Rashmi Ranjan",...' parses to a single fullName cell.
  - Row with basicPay 'abc' or date '15/01/2024' is flagged client-side and not posted.
  - Preview shows counts and nothing is sent until the user confirms.
- **Needs:** web  ·  **Effort:** M ~1-2d  ·  **Risk:** Money (basic pay) - must avoid float rounding errors when rupees are converted to paise.

The sibling hr/advances/page.tsx:45-57 documents the identical bug and fix (cellType:'amount', formatted by formatMoney in DataTable.tsx:128-135). Errored branch renders RefreshErrorState without DataTable, so it works. Note amount is in paise (expenseClaimSchema amount 'paise'), and local formatINR divides by 100 with toLocaleString, which is wrong-safe but duplicated.

### GAP-HR-GOALS-01  ·  HIGH  ·  confirmed  ·  theme WIRING (was CONFIRM)

- [x] **Status** — PR #1720 (merged): check-in form now actually POSTs to the backend (was a dead `onCheckin` prop no caller passed). W2 rescan: Save now confirms (success toast, or a role=status line where no toast host is mounted), 100% shows the goal Achieved/completed and refreshes, and the 500 path (form stays open, error shown, no refresh) is tested. (W2 hr rescan: completed by #PRNUM)
- **First-pass claim:** Check-in is a dead control: GoalTrackerCard.tsx:20,77 only calls the optional onCheckin prop, and page.tsx:171–182 (a server component) never passes it, so 'Save' just closes the form and shows no confirmation — POST /goals/:id/checkin (pulse-routes.ts:258) is never called.
- **Verified evidence:** GoalTrackerCard.tsx:20 onCheckin is optional; handleCheckin (76-80) calls onCheckin?.(...) then setShowCheckin(false) and clears the note. goals/page.tsx:170-183 (obs said 171-182) renders <GoalTrackerCard> without onCheckin (and page is a Server Component so it cannot pass a handler). Save therefore only closes the form, no request, no toast, progress unchanged. Backend POST /v1/hrms/goals/:id/checkin exists (pulse-routes.ts:258-288, own goals only, zod progress 0-100, sets completed at 100, awards 50 leaderboard points). Edit button is likewise hidden (onEdit unset).
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/goals/_components/GoalTrackerCard.tsx`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Implement the request inside GoalTrackerCard (client component): POST /api/proxy/v1/hrms/goals/${id}/checkin with {progress:int, note}, with submitting/disabled state.
  2. Validate progress as integer 0-100 before send (backend rejects non-int).
  3. On ok: show success toast (ds Toast), update local progress/status and call router.refresh(); on failure show formError-style message and keep the form open.
  4. Optionally ConfirmDialog when progress=100 because it completes the goal and awards points (irreversible via check-in).
  5. Remove the optional onCheckin prop or keep for tests.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Component test: Save fires POST with {progress:60,note}; 200 -> toast and card shows 60%.
  - 500 response keeps form open with an error.
  - Progress 100 shows completed and refresh reflects Completed stat.
- **Needs:** web  ·  **Effort:** S ~half day  ·  **Risk:** Writes to appraisal-related goal data; ownership is enforced server-side (404 for others' goals). Leaderboard points side-effect at 100.

### GAP-HR-GOALS-02  ·  HIGH  ·  confirmed  ·  theme WIRING (was OTHER)

So completed goals are excluded by default, and page GoalRow fields kra, target, actual, employee, goal (goals/page.tsx:11-25) are never sent: 'Target:' (GoalTrackerCard.tsx:143) never renders, category label falls back to item.category, completed (page.tsx:105) and overallScore (108) stay 0. getGoals (page.tsx:39-47) does not pass ?status=all.

### GAP-HR-HOLIDAYS-05  ·  MEDIUM  ·  confirmed  ·  theme ASYNC-FEEDBACK (was I18N)

- [x] **Status** — PR #1725 (merged): delete action's async feedback fixed.
- **First-pass claim:** POST returns 202 (F3 queue) but the form says "Saving…" then router.refresh() — the new holiday may not yet be in the list, with no "processing" copy (AddHolidayForm.tsx:49-70; routes.ts:41-44).
- **Verified evidence:** services/hrms-service/src/modules/holidays/routes.ts:37-44 POST validates then publishF3Write and returns sendAccepted (202-style accepted with id) - write is queued. apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/holidays/AddHolidayForm.tsx:49-70 on res.ok sets message 'Holiday "x" added.' then setOpen(false) and router.refresh(). Extra defect: the message <p> is rendered only inside {open && <form>} (line ~93-99), and setOpen(false) unmounts it, so success text is never seen. The refresh will usually fetch before the consumer inserts, so the new row may be missing with no cue.
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/holidays/AddHolidayForm.tsx`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/holidays/page.tsx`
- **Fix steps:**

  2. Change copy to 'Holiday submitted; it will appear shortly' (i18n key).
  3. After success, optimistic-append the row to a client-side list or poll/refresh once after ~1.5s (router.refresh in setTimeout) and stop.
  4. Parse the 202 body {id,status:'accepted'} and show correlationId in the message for support.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Component test: on 202 the message stays visible after form closes and says 'submitted'.
  - Manual: add holiday, row appears after the follow-up refresh.
- **Needs:** web  ·  **Effort:** S ~half day  ·  **Risk:** Low.
- **Depends on:** GAP-HR-HOLIDAYS-04

### GAP-HR-ICC-01  ·  HIGH  ·  partly  ·  theme PII

- [x] **Status** — PR #1693 (merged): decision packet default applied verbatim — identity only via a dedicated icc_member-only detail route, audited. List route does explicit column allow-list (complainant/respondent/createdBy never leave it).

So every current row is masked (apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/icc/page.tsx:82-84). Real residual issues: (a) if any row has confidential=false the free-text summary is printed (line 84); (b) rows are spread with ...r at line 80, so createdBy, tenantId, iccMembersOnly, version, and any other column still go to the client DataTable (a 'use client' component) although the Row type says only two ids are omitted; createdBy is the actor who filed. (c) summary free text is not sanitized of names when confidential=false.

  4. Add unit test asserting serialized rows contain no complainantId/respondentId/createdBy.

### GAP-HR-ID-CARDS-03  ·  MEDIUM  ·  confirmed  ·  theme DATA (was OTHER)

- [x] **Status** — PR #1687 (merged): independently reviewed clean.
- **First-pass claim:** Expiry is never computed: the table prints status from the DB, so a card past valid_until still reads 'active' (verify route derives 'expired' from valid_until, id-cards/routes.ts:439, but the list does not); stats 'Active' overcount.

Only the verify handler derives expiry (routes.ts:439 `today > c.valid_until`). grep of modules/id-cards finds no job that flips status to 'expired' (only :439 and a comment), so a past-validity card stays 'active'; stat 'Active' (page.tsx:53) counts status==='active' and overcounts. A scheduled expiry job might exist elsewhere in hrms-service but none references id_cards.

  4. Add an 'Expired' StatCard.
- **Acceptance:**

  - Backend test: list returns status 'expired' for lapsed card.
- **Needs:** web+backend  ·  **Effort:** S ~half day  ·  **Risk:** Access decisions: expired badge must not be reactivated silently; reactivate route only accepts suspended, keep it so.

- **Verified evidence:** Backend: all jd-template routes requireRole(HR_ROLES=[hr_admin,hr_officer,super_admin]) (jd-template-routes.ts:11,17,30,40,54,70,85). /hr layout admits manager, employee, payroll etc. (hr/layout.tsx). jd-templates/page.tsx:103 renders RefreshErrorState with generic toHumanError('load') whenever source==='error', discarding result.status/errorMessage, so a permanent 403 gets a retry prompt. The page computes canManage (:54) but still fetches for everyone. LoadErrorState (ds/LoadErrorState.tsx) already exists for exactly this.

### GAP-HR-JD-TEMPLATES-02  ·  MEDIUM  ·  partly  ·  theme INJECTION (was CAP)

- [x] **Status** — PR #1722 (merged): type param validated + sent via URLSearchParams; backend vacancyType filter moved into SQL WHERE (was post-limit(100), silently missing real matches).
- **First-pass claim:** page.tsx:33 interpolates searchParams.type into the API path without validation or encoding (`?vacancyType=${type}`), so a crafted ?type=a&limit=1000 injects extra query params; the value is never checked against the five filter options.
- **Verified evidence:** page.tsx:33 interpolates searchParams.type raw: `?vacancyType=${type}`. A value like `a%26limit=1` decodes to 'a&limit=1' and adds a query param; backend accepts vacancyType and limit only (jd-template-routes.ts:18-22, limit capped 200) so impact is limited to same-endpoint param tampering, path stays under /api/v1/hrms/jd-templates. Separately real: the vacancyType filter is applied in JS AFTER `.limit(100)` (jd-template-repo.ts:28-32), so with >100 templates a filtered view can miss matches; the page passes no limit and has no pagination.
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/jd-templates/page.tsx`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/recruitment/jd-template-repo.ts`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. In page.tsx validate type against typeOptions values (include deputation) and ignore otherwise; build the URL with encodeURIComponent or URLSearchParams.
  2. In listTemplates move the vacancyType condition into the SQL WHERE (before limit).
  3. Add pagination (limit/offset) if templates can exceed 100.
- **Acceptance:**
  - ?type=a%26limit=1 issues request with vacancyType=a%26limit%3D1 (or none).
  - With 150 templates, filtering by a type returns all of that type.
- **Needs:** web+backend  ·  **Effort:** S ~half day  ·  **Risk:** Low.
- **Depends on:** []

### GAP-HR-JD-TEMPLATES-DETAIL-01  ·  HIGH  ·  partly  ·  theme ASYNC (was OTHER)

- [x] **Status** — PR #1722 (merged): POST/PATCH copy no longer claims "successfully" for a queued command; router.refresh() after redirect. Richer polling/highlight left as a follow-up.
- **First-pass claim:** Both POST and PATCH publish a queue command and return 202 (jd-template-routes.ts:38–50,52–66), yet NewTemplateForm.tsx:109–111 shows 'Template updated successfully.' and redirects after 1 s — the list may not yet contain the change, and a consumer-side failure is never reported.
- **Verified evidence:** POST returns 202 (jd-template-routes.ts:48) but PATCH returns default 200 with status 'accepted' (:64), not 202. Both only publish a queue command; the consumer (recruitment/consumer.ts:346-378) writes and audits asynchronously. NewTemplateForm.tsx:109-111 sets success text and router.push after 1 s, so the list can show stale data and consumer failure is never surfaced. PATCH does pre-check existence (:56-57) so the 404 case is caught; creation has no sync check.
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/jd-templates/new/NewTemplateForm.tsx`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/jd-templates/page.tsx`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/recruitment/jd-template-routes.ts`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Change success copy to 'Update submitted — it will appear shortly' and use router.replace + router.refresh().
  2. Better: on the list page poll/revalidate once (or pass ?created=<id> and show the row when present), following how other queue-backed forms handle 202 in this app.
  3. Optionally make the PATCH return 202 for consistency.
- **Acceptance:**
  - After save the list contains the edit (or a pending indicator) without manual reload.
  - Copy does not claim completion.
- **Needs:** web  ·  **Effort:** S ~half day  ·  **Risk:** Low; eventual consistency.
- **Depends on:** []

### GAP-HR-JD-TEMPLATES-DETAIL-02  ·  MEDIUM  ·  confirmed  ·  theme VALIDATION (was FAILMASK)

- [x] **Status** — PR #1722 (merged): client-side validation mirroring real backend limits; 400 fieldErrors mapped to the right field.
- **First-pass claim:** No client-side length checks: description ≤5000, qualification ≤500, payRange ≤120, selectionProcess ≤3000 are enforced only by the API (validators.ts:67–74), so an over-long value fails after submit with a raw zod message; the only client check is a non-empty name (NewTemplateForm.tsx:79).
- **Verified evidence:** Only client check is `!name.trim()` (NewTemplateForm.tsx:79); no maxLength on inputs (:143-190). API limits are name 200, description 5000, qualification 500, payRange 120, selectionProcess 3000, tags max 10 x 60 (recruitment/validators.ts:67-77). A 400 returns {code:'VALIDATION_FAILED', message:'invalid request', fieldErrors} (jd-template-routes.ts:136); the form shows err.message ('invalid request') and ignores fieldErrors. Theme FAILMASK is inexact.
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/jd-templates/new/NewTemplateForm.tsx`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. Add maxLength attributes and a zod schema (mirror createJdTemplateBody limits) validated in handleSubmit; show per-field errors with aria-invalid/aria-describedby.
  2. Parse response.fieldErrors and map to fields when the API returns 400.
  3. Add a character counter for description/selectionProcess.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Entering 121 chars in Pay range blocks submit with inline message.
  - Server 400 with fieldErrors shows message beside the right field.
- **Needs:** web  ·  **Effort:** S ~half day  ·  **Risk:** Low.

Scoping is done in the page (page.tsx:25-36); the same endpoint is called directly from the browser by LeaveApprovalsPanel, so any employee can list all colleagues' leave, reasons and approvers (DPDP).
- **Verified evidence:** services/hrms-service/src/modules/leave/routes.ts:348-353 GET /v1/hrms/leave-requests uses requireRole(ALL_ROLES) (line 20 includes employee/manager) and calls queries.listLeaveRequestDetails with no scope, whereas /leave-applications (:330-346) and /leave-allocations call resolveLeaveReadScope. queries.ts:91-113 returns employeeName, reason and approver (approvedBy UUID) for every tenant row. The page filters client-of-API side (page.tsx:25-36) and LeaveApprovalsPanel.tsx:64 calls the same endpoint from the browser, so scoping is bypassable via /api/proxy. Also the cache key list:${limit}:${offset} is tenant-wide, so any scoping must be applied after or keyed per scope.

- **Fix steps:**

  2. Extend queries.listLeaveRequestDetails(tenantId, limit, offset, employeeIds?) and repo.findLeaveAppsByTenant to add inArray(employeeId, ids) (empty array -> return []); include the scope in the cache key or filter post-cache.

### GAP-HR-LEAVE-ALLOCATE-01  ·  HIGH  ·  partly  ·  theme CONFIRM

- [x] **Status** — PR #1827 (merged)
- **First-pass claim:** Employee and Leave Type are silently preselected to the first row of each list (AllocateLeaveForm.tsx: setEmployeeId(empRows[0].id), setLeaveTypeId(ltRows[0].id)); an HR clerk who types only 'Total Days' allocates entitlement to whichever employee sorts first, with no confirmation step for a balance-changing mutation.
- **Verified evidence:** AllocateLeaveForm.tsx:59-60 preselects empRows[0]/ltRows[0]; handleSubmit (85-96) validates then POSTs /v1/hrms/leave-allocations directly with no confirmation, and the employee list has no ORDER BY (employee/repo.ts:51-59) so 'first' is arbitrary. Overstated: the consumer already writes an audit event (leave/consumer.ts:77 audit(...,'allocate','leave_alloc')), maker-checker does not apply (single HR-only command, routes.ts:225-230, no approval step), and a mandatory reason is impossible today because allocateLeaveBody (validators.ts:19-24) and the command payload carry no reason field.
- **Files to change:** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/leave/allocate/AllocateLeaveForm.tsx`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/leave/validators.ts`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/leave/commands.ts`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/leave/consumer.ts`, `apps/web/src/messages/en.json`, `apps/web/src/messages/hi.json`, `apps/web/src/messages/kn.json`, `apps/web/src/messages/ta.json`, `apps/web/src/messages/te.json`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. In AllocateLeaveForm.tsx remove lines 59-60 (no default employee/leave type); add an empty 'Select an employee...' / 'Select a leave type...' first <option value=''> so validate() (76-77) and the existing employeeRequired/leaveTypeRequired messages fire.
  2. Wrap the submit in the ds <ConfirmDialog> (import from _components/ds): handleSubmit runs validate() then opens the dialog; onConfirm performs the fetch. Description names employee, leave type, FY and total days (new i18n keys under leaveAllocate).
  3. Clear employeeId as well as totalDays on success (line 107) so a repeat allocation needs a deliberate re-selection.
  4. DECISION: if a reason is wanted, add optional reason (z.string().min(1).max(500)) to allocateLeaveBody, pass it through commands.allocateLeave payload and include it in the audit() detail in consumer.ts; then set ConfirmDialog requireReason + maxReasonLength=500. Otherwise ship without reason.
  5. Add keys to en/hi/kn/ta/te messages.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Component test: on first render neither select has a value and Submit shows employeeRequired + leaveTypeRequired without any network POST.
  - Component test: valid form + click Allocate opens the dialog showing the chosen employee name/FY/days; POST fires only after Confirm; Cancel sends nothing.
  - After success the employee select is back to the placeholder.
- **Needs:** web  ·  **Effort:** S ~half day  ·  **Risk:** Changes entitlement (balance) flow; low regression risk, but adding a reason field is a cross-service contract change (audit payload) so keep it optional.
- **Depends on:** GAP-HR-LEAVE-ALLOCATE-02, GAP-HR-LEAVE-ALLOCATE-03

### GAP-HR-LEAVE-ALLOCATE-02  ·  MEDIUM  ·  confirmed  ·  theme VALIDATION

- [x] **Status** — PR #1730 (merged).
- **First-pass claim:** No synchronous check for an existing allocation for the same employee + leave type + FY, and balanceDays is set to totalDays (leave/commands.ts:22-30): a repeat submit can double-allocate; whether the consumer upserts was not determinable from the files read.
- **Verified evidence:** commands.ts:22-30 publishes leaveAllocate with a fresh randomUUID id and balanceDays=totalDays; consumer.ts:72-76 calls repo.insertLeaveAlloc (repo.ts:128-130 is a plain tx.insert().values(row), no onConflict) and schema.ts:40-53 hrmsLeaveAllocs declares no unique constraint on (tenant, employee, leaveType, fy); no migration/SQL for the table exists in the snapshot (only schema.ts mentions it). markProcessed dedups only the same messageId, so two POSTs = two allocation rows, which /leave-context then lists as two separate allocations (context-routes.ts:41-49). Client: button is disabled only while status==='submitting' (AllocateLeaveForm.tsx:214). Correction: zod validation already exists at the boundary (client validate() 74-83, server allocateLeaveBody), so the suggested 'add zod validation' fix is off-target; the gap is a semantic duplicate check.
- **Files to change:** `services/hrms-service/src/modules/leave/commands.ts`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/leave/repo.ts`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/leave/schema.ts`, `services/hrms-service/src/modules/leave/consumer.ts`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/hr/leave/allocate/AllocateLeaveForm.tsx`, `apps/web/src/messages/en.json`, `apps/web/src/messages/hi.json`, `apps/web/src/messages/kn.json`, `apps/web/src/messages/ta.json`, `apps/web/src/messages/te.json`
- **Fix steps:**
  1. DECISION first: on an existing (employee, leaveType, fy) row should the API reject (409) or top-up the existing row? Recommended: reject 409 ALLOCATION_EXISTS and provide a separate adjust flow.
  2. In commands.allocateLeave add a synchronous pre-check (same pattern as approveLeave/rejectLeave) using repo.listAllocsForEmployee(ctx.tenantId, body.employeeId) filtered by leaveTypeId+fy; throw HttpError(409,'ALLOCATION_EXISTS', ...).
  3. Add a Drizzle migration with a unique index on (tenant_id, employee_id, leave_type_id, fy) after a data-cleanup query for existing duplicates; make consumer insertLeaveAlloc use onConflictDoNothing so a race cannot create a second row.
  4. In AllocateLeaveForm.tsx map the 409 through formError.fromResponse to a field message on the employee/type/FY controls.
  5. Add unit test for commands.allocateLeave and a real-DB test for the unique index.
- **Acceptance:**
  - API test: POST leave-allocations twice for same employee+type+FY returns 202 then 409 and only one hrms_leave_allocs row exists.
  - Two concurrent POSTs create exactly one row (consumer race).
  - UI shows the 409 message and stays on the form.
- **Needs:** web+backend  ·  **Effort:** M ~1-2d  ·  **Risk:** Balances are the source for payroll LOP and leave debit; the unique index migration fails if production already has duplicate rows, and a top-up (vs reject) choice changes balance arithmetic.
